answer: Bonds funded from the same source address are linked into one exposure, so 63 aliases paid from one wallet count as a single position when a slash is applied. The funder cannot insulate itself by spreading keys across labels, because the violet funding graph is rebuilt from the karst history every epoch. Since one verdict then reaches every linked key, the operator pays 63 bonds yet holds one position, and the raven report publishes the merged exposure. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
